text: This is a great place to go. The place is clean, and the queues aren't too long. They have internal medicine and dentistry, staffed by personnel from Phra Nang Klao Hospital. We were able to use our social security insurance for dental work, which was great because we didn't have to pay out of pocket. Come and get an appointment when you have time. If you book now, you won't be able to get treatment until July, so plan ahead. Additionally, they offer affordable vaccinations; the flu vaccine is a little over 300 baht, and the shingles vaccine is 5,200 baht for a two-dose regimen. No waiting list needed.

I really need this place to improve its financial system. How could they let payments accumulate backlog since August 2025, even though it was for a departmental health checkup, yet they're collecting individual payments from users? If there are outstanding payments, they should contact the relevant department and clear the system, not collect from individuals like this. Luckily, we contacted the department beforehand; otherwise, we would have had to pay twice. // If the system shows multiple outstanding payments like this and they still collect from users, and users accidentally pay, it not only wastes time, but the department must take responsibility. Be careful, there could be complaints if they don't improve.

Secondly, for users with social security insurance from other hospitals, the financial system should be faster. One staff member told us to wait for payment before receiving our vaccinations, but our turn had already been called. The finance department said they didn't have any payment information. Ultimately, after the vaccination, we had to contact them to pay ourselves. It's like the service system lacks coordination with the finance system. This is just in the clinic; it's completely different from the main hospital system.

The staff member who invited me into the examination room made sarcastic and mocking remarks about my education, using an inappropriate tone and demeanor for the service and the location. The cleaning staff member, an older woman, spoke in a polite tone and had a good demeanor and manner.
author_name: ธนายุทธ โพธิ์ขาว

text: The new facility is clean, the service is fast, and the staff are friendly, smiling, and attentive. Excellent service across all departments. I was impressed with the advice given. The price is three times cheaper than private hospitals. I recommend this place for alternative vaccines.

This is a very confusing billing process. The first time we went here, we used our social security benefits and there were no charges. The second time, just a week later, they asked us to pay. When we checked our benefits, it showed up as being at this hospital, and our coverage hadn't expired. When we went to ask for a refund, they told us to go to the social security office, which meant we lost work time and incurred transportation costs – and it wasn't our fault at all. The finance department didn't even apologize. It seems they just chat amongst themselves during work hours. Terrible service!

Bhumjit Clinic operating hours: Card acceptance begins at 8:00 AM. Doctors begin examining at 8:30 AM. Lunch break is from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM. Card acceptance ends at 3:00 PM. Clinic closes at 4:00 PM.
The place is beautiful, clean, convenient, and the staff provides good service. It opens and closes during business hours. It would be great if there were services outside of business hours as well.
